findings.text: follow-on: the base arm did not measure the base revision -- it records cwd as the head worktree and module.__file__ as that worktree's reckon/budget.py, so the PYTHONPATH scratch tree was shadowed and the arm ran head code, leaving the baseline_suite row's revision attribution unsupported (bounded because the head arm reports zero failures and nothing needed attributing).

follow-on: the utilisation assertions at :145-146 compare against the values the test handed in at :142 and hold under the reinstated record-stamp regression, so they are wiring checks, not coverage of the dating fix whose guard is :147.

follow-on: the negative-control log quotes a test revision naming the stamps T0/T1/T2 and reports the first failure at line 123, one line off the committed test text, so the merged assertions were not the artefact it reddened.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 984cb5efb; the single gained commit 9f9209bc2 extracts a shared _read_rollout_event out of paid_lanes._codex_rollout_candidates, adds RolloutEvent/_session_rollout_paths/read_session_rollout_event, points budget._read_live_rollout at that reader, and reworks the two test files plus the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a three-source competition in tests/test_pace_dates_a_rollout_by_its_report.py plus the event-stamp rewrite of tests/test_preflight_pace.py::test_a_live_session_is_read_for_the_rollout_receipt_of_its_own_run; both are present and green, and the manifest records the head gate 637 passed EXIT=0 and the negative control 2 failed EXIT=1, but the recorded base arm does not measure the base revision.
item_verdicts.goal: the source node's goal is to date a live run's rollout figure on the pace path by its own rate_limits event; commit 9f9209bc2 makes reckon/budget.py:3537 build the live session's candidate from paid_lanes.read_session_rollout_event, whose RolloutEvent carries the provider's own stamp at reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:936.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it declares status complete and commit 9f9209bc2, gate head 637 passed EXIT=0 and base 634 passed EXIT=0 over the budget-importing test files, the declared negative control red (2 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1), and names gate-base.log/gate-head.log/negative-control.log as its logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the source dispatch fence (reckon/budget.py, reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py, tests/test_preflight_pace.py, tests/test_pace_dates_a_rollout_by_its_report.py, the plan evidence fragment and its figure dir); git diff 984cb5efb..9f9209bc2 touches only those paths and nothing outside.

justifications.durability: tests/test_pace_dates_a_rollout_by_its_report.py:124 and :147 fail when record-stamp dating is restored (negative control 2 failed EXIT=1), but the utilisation assertions at :145-146 hold under that regression because the rollout is the only candidate there.
justifications.evidence: gate-base.log:5 records module.__file__ as the head worktree's reckon/budget.py, so the base arm ran head code and the done_when's no-added-failure-against-base clause rests on the head arm's zero failures rather than on a genuine base measurement.
justifications.fit: the lazy import of paid_lanes at reckon/budget.py:3668 avoids the cycle that paid_lanes' own budget._read_rollout use at paid_lanes.py:815 would otherwise create, and the new names carry no plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/budget.py:3537 dates the live session's candidate from _read_live_rollout, which resolves paid_lanes.read_session_rollout_event and takes the event's own stamp at reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:936, so an older figure can no longer outrank a newer one.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:892 extracts _read_rollout_event out of the tail-reader previously inlined in _codex_rollout_candidates, and both the account scan and budget.py's pace path resolve through read_session_rollout_event, so no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: every diff path is inside the fence, but reckon/budget.py:261, :2826 and :2899 carry unrelated ruff reformatting (timezone.utc to UTC, slice spacing, an argument wrap) the goal does not imply.
